title: Thermal slider fixes (PR 96) re-verified in real Chrome

environment.base: worktree p-d merged with origin/main including PR 96
environment.browser: real Chrome (Claude in Chrome), own tab (not the selected tab), vite dev on 127.0.0.1:5174, stdio connector; Chrome auto-translation to Japanese active (some dynamic text translated)
environment.setup: thermal-demo, #transient-heat on, 2 s x 40 steps, #thermal-snapshots 21, mesh 4 mm (frame slider 0..20, final 80 s / step 40)
environment.errors: no window errors or unhandled rejections recorded

checks.detail: final step: T(5,5,20)=40.967109648913144 and T(5,5,40)=99.99999999999996 (bit-identical to before), heat flux present, view timeSelection viewer-slider-only
frame 7 (28 s): T(5,5,20)=25.27171422034722 (not the final 40.97), flux omitted, frameTimeSeconds 28, interpolated false
fine slider 275 (22 s, between frames 5 and 6): T(5,5,20)=23.340062830457093, flux omitted, frameTimeSeconds 22, interpolated true

probe mode click at the same surface point: interpolated 22 s 'Temperature 25.702 C / t = 22.0000 s (interpolated)'; frame 7 'Temperature 28.358 C / t = 28.0000 s'; final 'Temperature 46.136 C / Heat flux 4785.9 W/m2' (no time text, flux present)
physicalTimeSeconds 80 / 28 / 22, interpolated false / false / true, timeSelection 'viewer-slider-only', frameCount 21; state.frameIndex stays null for thermal
setResultView {deformScale:1} at the interpolated 22 s time kept physicalTimeSeconds 22, interpolated true, and the page slider unchanged

stills at 22 s (interpolated), 28 s and 80 s differ (6,977 / 52,497 / 54,652 differing pixels between pairs; screenshot montage thermal-stills-22-28-80.png in verify3/); export metadata manifest.view.timeSeconds and manifest.time.physicalTimeSeconds record 22 / 28 / 80, timeBasis 'single frame'

png-sequence orbit and slice at the 22 s interpolated time completed, manifests record physicalTimeSeconds/viewTime 22, and the page slider stayed at fine 275 / frame 5 / 22 s with the Interpolated label afterwards. deformation refused for thermal ('Deformation requires a structural or modal result.')
refused at start: 'Time playback export is not supported for thermal results yet.'

startExport is accepted and the job then fails (state failed, progress 0) with 'Time playback export is not supported for thermal results yet. Use the viewer slider and a still PNG or an orbit animation.' - i.e. refused by the job, not at start (unlike png-sequence)
timeAnimationResultKinds ['acousticTransient'] and stillTime 'displayed-time-recorded-for-thermal' present; timeSelection still reads 'stored-acoustic-frames-only' (unchanged legacy field)

after loading the axial bar demo, 'View saved result' for the saved 21-snapshot thermal case shows the thermal example name (heat conduction reference sample, displayed in Japanese by translation) with frames 0..20 and the thermal legend 20.00 -> 100.0 C

notVerified: Probe values against an independent reference (only monotonic plausibility and bit-identical final values)
Heat flux omission via the GUI at an interpolated time was seen only as absent text
webm time refusal at start (it fails in the job)
Japanese-language text of the new controls (Chrome translation interfered)
Foreground-tab behaviour (tab was not the selected tab)
